name: correction-ledger
description: Saves each correction you make as a rule, sends it every turn or when Claude makes the call it is about, makes it louder each time it is broken, and removes it when it is no longer used.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that decides whether a prompt is a correction: haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id.

maxRules.title: Rules kept per project
maxRules.description: How many rules a project keeps. Past this, the rule broken least often and unused longest goes.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model before dropping a check.

taskDays.title: Life of a task rule (worked days)
taskDays.description: How many days of work in the project a rule for the job in hand lasts when you do not repeat it.

ruleDays.title: Life of a project rule (worked days)
ruleDays.description: How many days of work in the project a project rule lasts when you do not repeat or keep it.
